_about: THREAT-MODEL T10. Every image this repository pins by digest (scripts/image_pins.py) is listed here by repository: under `signed` with who must have signed it -- CI runs `cosign verify` on every pinned digest of it (scripts/verify-image-signatures.py) -- or under `unsigned` with why there is nothing to check. tests/unit/test_image_signers.py fails on an image that is in neither. Surveyed 2026-10-15 with `cosign tree` (tag-based and OCI-referrer signatures) and GitHub's attestation API. Scanner images whose publisher signs release files rather than images are built from those files instead (docker/grype, syft, osv-scanner, opengrep, checkov).

ghcr.io/sigstore/cosign/cosign.note: Sigstore's own release build (Google Cloud Build). The pinned digest is still the trust anchor for the verifier itself: this check catches a pin to an image Sigstore never signed.
